name: @swao/module-portfolio
description: SWAO portfolio orchestration module (Enterprise tier): the spawn-based PortfolioOrchestrator that discovers apps under <workspace>/apps/ and dispatches a swao CLI run per app (swao assess --app <id>, report --app <id>, ...), aggregating per-app ok/fail status -- plus the PortfolioScreen TUI. ADR-0048 modular architecture, Phase 5, #0579. The general per-app dispatcher is separate from the existing --portfolio --lzr aggregate (runPortfolioLzr stays host-side, LZR-specific). The orchestrator never imports assess/report/export code (that would be module->module); it spawns the host CLI exactly like @swao/module-mcp. The swao CLI invocation is host-injected (PortfolioHostDeps { swaoCliPath, cliIsScript } + resolveSpawn, mirroring McpHostDeps): the host computes it in index.ts (pkg binary -> process.execPath; dev -> the host entry via node) and builds the production runForApp. The runtime gate stays requireTier('enterprise', ...) on the three --portfolio flags (preserved, not a new decision).
